findings.evidence: She wanted that understood, if only to herself: there was no kindness in it.
findings.diagnosis: 'understood' is a banned filter word, and 'She wanted that understood' makes the character insist the no-kindness point be registered — tipping the de-valorizing into a stated-theme lecture at the crux.

findings.evidence: The man saw them the same second she did.
